verdict.rationale: Docs describe uploading/scanning invoices, automating invoice payments and approval flows, and paying vendors across 150+ countries, plus MCP tooling to review bill-pay invoices and manage vendors, covering the core story of upload→approve→pay. Missing for 10: detailed documentation of multi-step/role-based approval configuration, screenshots or hands-on walkthrough of the approval UI, and independent corroboration beyond vendor docs.
